narrative: A fresh sheet, headed with nothing but a place he does not write. The rest is blank. The garden sheet is face-down at the side, so this one cannot borrow an ending from it. One line, low on the page, and then the pen capped.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the sheet almost empty, on purpose.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in An empty block
